themes.name: Last Set, Ivory
themes.description: A late-night editorial journal drawn from the amber haze of a closing jazz set — tarnished brass type, oxblood shadows, and ivory breath between columns.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: The last tune fades. Brass still warm. Ivory keys cooling under a single bulb. This is the journal of that exact room.

themes.name: Slab & Canopy
themes.description: A Niemeyer terrace translated into graphic poster language — deep shade, sculptural type, and the slow heat of a Brazilian afternoon rendered in flat material planes.

props.text: Niemeyer poured concrete into shadow. We pour ink into structure. The canopy holds the heat still — flat planes, brutal brackets, and a terrace that refuses to apologize for its geometry.
The afternoon slows. The slab casts its geometry onto the ground — a sundial that measures heat, not hours.

themes.name: Velvet Incunabula
themes.description: Dark Academia meets pre-dawn stillness — aged parchment and forest ink, scholarly serif authority, cards like vellum manuscript pages lit by a single candle.

props.text: Candlelit vellum. Forest ink. The hour before the monastery stirs — every card a manuscript page, every word an act of scholarly devotion.
Source Serif 4 — a candlelit desk, a marginalia-filled folio.

themes.name: Graphite Meridian
themes.description: Tadao Ando's concrete chapel at dawn — a blade of warm light cuts through heavy shadow, structure and silence in equal measure.

props.text: Concrete breathes here. A blade of warm amber splits the grey before the world wakes — Ando's chapel distilled into type and grid.
Structure and silence in equal measure.

themes.name: Concrete & Aureole
themes.description: Tadao Ando's blade of light through raw concrete — restrained mass meeting transcendent warmth, images emerging from deep shadow like devotional objects.

props.text: A blade of gold through raw concrete. The image as devotional object — held in shadow until it must be seen.

themes.name: Amber Signal
themes.description: A dawn editorial journal where warm amber ink meets deep indigo shadow — the quiet glow of a Tokyo vending machine on a rain-soaked side street, rendered in measured print hierarchy.

props.text: The vending machine hums amber through the rain. Ink finds hierarchy. Dawn finds its page.
A rain-soaked side street, measured in print.

themes.name: Iris & Gilt
themes.description: Art Nouveau poster elegance at dawn — organic botanical letterforms bloom against a misty lavender ground, gilded accents catching the first light.

body.name: IBM Plex Mono
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace

props.text: Where botanical letterforms bloom at the gilded hour — lavender mist, bracketed links, and the weight of serif petals catching first light.
